author: magiika
quote:
Metacritic deleting reviews is not going to change the fact  that the game falls short of expectations and caters to a very different crowd than it was marketed towards.

Chores for obnoxious girlfriend that you can't leave simulator. Very, very clearly not made by the same people as the previous games, nor for the same audience. A crime sandbox with less freedom to do crimes than previous games in the same series is definitely a strange choice by the studio. Lucia is clearly the self-insert of the developers, which is why they put her on a pedestal even when there are far better options to date in the game, except they don't let us do that, no we have to stay with this horrible person. The game is mediocre and boring. 

To make matters worse, it's slow and buggy. Imagine waiting 13 years for an unstable 30fps in 2026. It's ridiculous. 60fps is the bare minimum. The game is pretty, but it's not wildly different in graphics from GTA V, there is no valid reason for why it's 30fps.
